brief: Asserts that value is dataType yearMonthDuration
description: Returns value unchanged if it is dataType yearMonthDuration. Otherwise, including when value is undefined, throws an error. It never converts: to get a yearMonthDuration from a value of another data type, write a typed literal or call a to_ function. This is usually written value as yearMonthDuration.

errorsThrown.reason: value is not the asserted data type
